scenarios.causalMutation: Execute arbitrary Lua for simulation.

diagnostics.message: Arbitrary Lua execution is forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Duplicate an actor id across row records.

diagnostics.message: Actor ids must be unique.

scenarios.causalMutation: Duplicate a faction id across row records.

diagnostics.message: Faction ids must be unique.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a family id outside the 3x3 proof matrix.

diagnostics.message: Family id must come from the accepted matrix.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a seed id outside seed_alpha/beta/gamma.

diagnostics.message: Seed id must come from the accepted matrix.

scenarios.causalMutation: Only vary ids or row hashes without living-world state axes.

diagnostics.message: Variance must include actor, faction, schedule and event axes.

scenarios.causalMutation: Set an NPC schedule to unavailable and active in the same tick.

diagnostics.message: Availability state must be coherent.

scenarios.causalMutation: Point a relation to an actor/faction that is not declared.

diagnostics.message: Relation endpoints must resolve to declared actors or factions.

scenarios.causalMutation: Generate or import media.

diagnostics.message: Media generation/import is forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove matching Goal 062 spatial detail evidence.

diagnostics.message: Goal 062 spatial detail source is required.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove the Goal 063 runtime-state-delta matrix before source loading.

diagnostics.message: Goal 063 gameplay consequence source is required.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim Unity proof while omitting required living-world markers.

diagnostics.message: Unity proof requires every planned marker.

scenarios.causalMutation: Emit a living-world row whose before and after hashes are equal.

diagnostics.message: Before and after state hashes must differ.

scenarios.causalMutation: Emit rows by filesystem enumeration order.

diagnostics.message: Rows must be sorted by family and seed order.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim provider, LLM or RAG work.

diagnostics.message: Provider, LLM and RAG calls are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Replay the same row input and produce different tick/state hashes.

diagnostics.message: Same input replay must be deterministic.

scenarios.causalMutation: Mutate Runtime, UI or public GamePackage schema for proof.

diagnostics.message: Runtime/UI/GamePackage schema mutation is forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Deserialize a different after-state hash.

diagnostics.message: Save/load roundtrip must preserve after-state hash.

scenarios.causalMutation: Create broad Unity gameplay systems as proof.

diagnostics.message: Only narrow Alpha marker support is allowed.

scenarios.causalMutation: Use path traversal in a source/staging path.

diagnostics.message: Paths must stay repository-relative and traversal-free.
